paragraphs: I replaced MyFitnessPal with my own AI agent.

Gordon is a nutrition agent I built on the Claude Agent SDK, and he's the first app in something bigger: the Batcave, a set of apps where each one is run by its own AI agent in production. Two weeks before a family vacation I started logging only with him, and it stuck.

What I like most is that he isn't just a chat box. He's wired into the phone. "Hey Siri, log food in Gordon" from the lock screen. A calorie ring and macros on my Apple Watch. Hold the mic and talk. Snap a plate or scan a barcode. A push notification when he's done.

All of it in a React Native app, and the same agent behind every one of those, plus Telegram and the web. Next up is Ra's, the training agent, so what I eat and how I train finally talk to each other.
If you had your own agent, which native feature would you wire it into first?
